messages.content: User task: Help me draft a short apology email to a colleague.

raw_response:
Subject: Sorry for the oversight

Hi [Colleague's Name],

I wanted to apologize for [specific action] that caused inconvenience. I understand it impacted your work and I regret any frustration it caused. I’m taking steps to ensure it doesn’t happen again, and I appreciate your patience. Please let me know if there’s anything else I can do to make things right.

Best regards,
[Your Name]

PLAN: Draft apology email with subject and body.
PLAN: Review tone and specificity.
PLAN: Provide final version to user.
